trigger: Initialize an unconfigured project; exercise host, CLI, Herdr and Orca, including each project Skill target for Herdr/Orca and optional CLI interaction preferences
expected: Offers four choices with host recommended; external defaults are preferred with host fallback. CLI may save its tool and headless or interactive preference without launching it. Only Herdr/Orca ask for a project Skill directory. Reuses the complete local Skill or directs the user to SKILLS-HUB; never downloads GitHub main or starts services.

trigger: Repeat initialization with saved host or external preferences; then explicitly change the default mode
expected: Displays and reuses valid preferences without asking again. Explicit changes replace defaults while preserving Work/stage rules and old third-party files; obsolete tool/model/guide fields are not carried into another mode. A saved preference alone does not authorize reinstalling a missing Skill.

trigger: Read-only initialization, plan-only initialization, unanswered/cancelled selection, or a normal Work without coordination configuration
expected: Does not install Skills, save defaults, start services or create business state; an unanswered choice is not treated as consent to persist host. A normal Work uses its current host without starting the initialization questionnaire.

trigger: Choose Herdr/Orca but its project Skill is missing, or a previous CLI installation was interrupted
expected: Keeps the saved preference and target, reports not installed and continues independent initialization with host fallback. Directs installation and transaction recovery to the Speculo CLI with its bundled automation/herdr or automation/orca package; never writes CLI metadata or installs from GitHub main.

trigger: Initialization encounters invalid configuration, configuration drift, a linked install path, an invalid same-name Skill or two local Skill candidates without a saved guide
expected: Preserves original files and stops only affected writes; invalid configuration does not trigger dependent installation. Ambiguous directories require a user choice; valid explicit guide paths are honored and no global Skill directory is substituted.

trigger: Execute an authorized task with preferred Herdr, Orca or CLI plus host fallback when its Skill, CLI, service, login or required environment is unavailable before dispatch
expected: Reports the unavailable capability and continues with the current agent without repeating the choice, changing saved preferences or installing/starting a service. Independent review still requires an eligible reviewer; an implementer cannot approve their own work.

trigger: A required tool or stage overrides an optional project default, or an external dispatch loses its response while the worker may still be writing
expected: Does not inherit lower-priority fallback for a forced choice. For uncertain dispatch, recovers the original task and verifies effects and stopped writers before continuing unfinished work; a service error never justifies duplicate execution.
